scope: Read-only asset inventory and Blender capabilities; one in-memory refine_character call. No .blend save, GLB export, full rebuild invocation, runtime edits or production asset changes.

probes.name: Read delivered Blender scene without saving
probes.command: blender -b assets/characters/keeper-prototype.blend --python-expr "import bpy,json; rig=next(o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='ARMATURE'); print('AUDIT_READ_ONLY',json.dumps({'blender':bpy.app.version_string,'bones':[b.name for b in rig.data.bones],'rigProperties':list(rig.keys()),'meshes':[{'name':o.name,'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials], 'meshProperties':list(o.data.keys()),'objectProperties':list(o.keys())} for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH']}))"

probes.name: Apply new refinement only to an unsaved in-memory scene
probes.command: blender -b assets/characters/keeper-prototype.blend --python-expr "import bpy,json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,'tools/blender'); import refine_football_model as m; rig=next(o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='ARMATURE'); objs=[o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH' and any(x.type=='ARMATURE' and x.object==rig for x in o.modifiers)]; before={o.name:[v.co.copy() for v in o.data.vertices] for o in objs}; beforeCounts=[(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons)) for o in objs]; m.refine_character(rig,True); objs2=[o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH' and any(x.type=='ARMATURE' and x.object==rig for x in o.modifiers)]; [o.data.calc_loop_triangles() for o in objs2]; print('AUDIT_IN_MEMORY_ONLY',json.dumps({'before':beforeCounts,'after':[(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons),len(o.data.loop_triangles)) for o in objs2],'triangles':sum(len(o.data.loop_triangles) for o in objs2),'rigProperties':list(rig.keys())}));"
probes.limit: This measures structural change only. It does not assert visual improvement or failure, exported file size, runtime compatibility, or the quality of the new jersey.

probes.name: Inspect installed Blender interfaces without running a build
probes.command: blender -b assets/characters/keeper-prototype.blend --python-expr "import bpy,importlib.util,json; action=next(iter(bpy.data.actions)); props=bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf.get_rna_type().properties.keys(); print('AUDIT_CAPABILITIES',json.dumps({'version':bpy.app.version_string,'actionLayers':hasattr(action,'layers'),'actionSlots':hasattr(action,'slots'),'meshoptExportProperty':'export_meshopt_compression_enable' in props,'meshoptModule':importlib.util.find_spec('io_scene_gltf2.io.exp.meshopt') is not None,'fullFileNoSave':True}))"

targetedChecks.scope: Current shipped asset identity and budgets, exact compressed Blender bytes, source BVH identity, compact clip source and bind rig, boot/support/final stance and continuity.

conclusion.proven: Current assets remain valid under the selected checks. Their editable scene lacks refinement custom flags; the new helper materially changes it in memory. Installed Blender lacks interfaces used by the new/modified build scripts.
conclusion.inferredFromOrder: refine_football_model.py saves the production .blend at line 126 before importing the unavailable meshopt module at line 127. A direct full rebuild on this environment risks partial overwrite before failure.
conclusion.notExecuted: No complete rebuild, no save_as_mainfile, no export_scene.gltf and no collision-cache regeneration.
